item.title: About
item.description: I am an Associate Professor of Economics and Public Policy at the LBJ School of Public Affairs and, by courtesy, in the Department of Economics at the University of Texas at Austin. I am also a research affiliate of the Cornell Institute for China Economic Research (CICER). In 2022-3, I was a Visiting Scholar at the Belfer Center at the Harvard Kennedy School. I am an applied microeconomist examining the relationship between environmental outcomes, urban and energy policies and inequality.
